name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (released 2026-07-04) is a major release with 238 commits, introducing Connect Knowledge for read-only cloud drive integration (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive/SharePoint, Dropbox), a 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), and per-room agent Channels. The release also includes a Telegram remote-control gateway, a 'Manila Arc' borderless UI redesign, clean-path routing replacing hash routing, improved auth with PBKDF2 password hashing and login rate-limiting, and numerous editor, task, and Windows fixes. See the full release notes at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits and multiple contributors
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, and KB_PASSWORD gate for daemon auth

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron. Old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser, but the canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful document management with OCR and tagging but is significantly heavier and more complex to self-host than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more feature-rich document management system with workflows and ACL controls, but comes with greater resource overhead compared to Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automatic document organization and tagging via AI/OCR pipelines but requires more infrastructure setup than Cabinet's simpler approach.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud Files
alternatives.review: Nextcloud Files is a broader file management and collaboration platform with extensive app integrations, making it much heavier but more versatile than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and self-hosted but focuses on being a universal file browser across storage backends rather than a dedicated document manager.
